task.title: Focus-ring polish: scrub ring-[3px] doc-comment debris, extend tw_merge regression coverage, unify ring widths
task.description:
Follow-ups from P6-022 adversarial review (all minor, none user-visible):

1. Dead CSS via doc comments: app/src/components/ui/button.rs:94,100 and item.rs:141 doc comments spell the literal ring-[3px] / focus-visible:ring-[3px]. Tailwind v4 source scanner extracts candidates from raw file text including comments, so the dead .ring-[3px] rules ship in app.css. Reword the comments and confirm the rules drop out of generated CSS.

2. Test coverage: the tw_merge regression tests cover only BUTTON_BASE and ITEM_BASE as bare consts. checkbox.rs:27 and toggle_group.rs:116 (function-local strings) have none, and the real call shape tw_merge!(BASE, variant.classes(), size.classes(), class) is untested — ButtonVariant::Destructive (which on old main lost its focus ring entirely: its focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 collided with the misclassified width) is the case worth pinning.

3. Width inconsistency (pre-existing): input.rs:85 and count_stepper.rs:357 use focus-visible:ring-2 while the other primitives now use ring-3. Decide one width and align.

Context: P6-022 (merged) fixed tw_merge 0.1.21 misclassifying arbitrary ring-[3px] as a ring colour, dropping ring-ring/50. input_group.rs was never actually affected — its has-[[...]]: prefix fails tw_merge variant parsing and the class passes through unmerged (see specs/phase-6-probes/batch-H-leptos.md P6-022 resolution note).
